hypotheses.justification: The proof works unchanged without this binder. The forward direction only transfers compactness and total disconnectedness along P.equiv. In the reverse direction, ProfiniteGrp.of requires Group, TopologicalSpace, IsTopologicalGroup, CompactSpace, and TotallyDisconnectedSpace, but not T2Space. Total disconnectedness supplies T1Space via TotallyDisconnectedSpace.t1Space, and a T1 topological group is Hausdorff. This includes the trivial group; Group G excludes the empty case.
